entry.title: Re: Natively ABAP Cloud (Clean Core) Add-ons in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition
entry.content:
@Marco_Valencia,

The Scalable Delivery option is a great step forward as it encourages partners to build on-stack ABAP add-ons for SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition and makes it easier for customers to discover and consume them through a centralised SAP Store experience.

Regarding the statement:

"Until December 2024, packaged ABAP Cloud add-ons were only available for SAP S/4HANA On-Premise and SAP S/4HANA Cloud, Private Edition. Now, they are natively available as clean-core solutions for SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud!"

It’s worth clarifying that delivering ABAP add-ons for S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition has been possible since at least 2023 via the Multi-off Delivery approach.

Importantly, regardless of the delivery method, all add-ons for SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition must follow the ABAP Cloud model — meaning they are clean core by design.

entry.title: Re: Natively ABAP Cloud (Clean Core) Add-ons in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition
entry.content:
@Marco_Valencia, 

I fully agree that the Scalable Delivery option offers a significantly improved experience for both partners and customers—it’s the ideal path forward.  However, to accelerate the growth of partner solutions delivered through this model, I encourage SAP to consider more flexible commercial terms for the required Partner Cloud test, demo, and development (TDD) landscape for SAP S/4HANA Cloud, public edition (SKU #8017424).  While the per-user pricing is perfectly reasonable, the current requirement to purchase in minimum blocks of 100 users creates a high barrier to entry for smaller partners who wish to innovate with packaged ABAP Cloud add-ons.

entry.title: Do standard business events exist for SAP PPM (Project and Portfolio Management)?
entry.content:
Hi Community,

I would like to know if standard business events are available for SAP PPM (Project and Portfolio Management), specifically for Portfolio Item Decision Point status changes?  None seem to be listed in SAP Business Accelerator Hub, nor are any listed in the PPM Help Documentation.

The use case involves triggering an SAP Build Process Automation Workflow via Event Mesh, when the status of a Portfolio Item Decision Point is changed.

In the absence of a standard business event, what is the recommended approach for creating a custom event for this scenario?:

  1. Use SAP NetWeaver Add-On for Event Enablement; or

  2. Use a RAP Business Event.  The issue I see with this approach is that we would need to create a custom RAP Business Event for a standard business object (Portfolio Item Decision Point),  when a corresponding RAP Business Object does not seem to exist.  Creating a Derived Business Event is also not an option because there is no standard Business Event to reference.   

Any suggestions would be greatly appreciated.

Thanks,
Mustafa.

entry.title: SAP Inside Track Sydney 2026 | Friday September 4, 9:00am - 6pm
entry.content:
SAP Inside Track Sydney 2026

A reimagined SAP community event focused on real-world insights, collaboration, and learning.


Event Details

Date: Friday, September 4, 2026 | 9am to 6pm
Location: The Mint, 10 Macquarie Street, Sydney
Format: Full-day, in-person event

* Please follow this page for updates on attendee registration, agenda announcements, speaker confirmations, and other event news.


Registration

Early Bird Registrations are now open!  Please register by following this link. 

Make sure you don't miss out on this year's reimagined SAP Inside Track Sydney.   Something special is in the works!

 

About the Event

SAP Inside Track Sydney 2026 brings the SAP Community together for a full day of learning, connection, and practical insight.

This year’s event is a refreshed take on the traditional SAP Inside Track format, with an elevated venue experience, a sharper agenda, and a strong focus on content that is relevant to today’s business environment and SAP landscape.

Expect a day of presentations, demos, hands-on labs, shaped by knowledge sharing, community spirit, and relevant discussion across the key topics influencing SAP customers and practitioners today.

Whether you are interested in enterprise architecture, SAP strategy, development, automation, data and AI, or customer experience, SAP Inside Track Sydney 2026 is designed to create valuable opportunities to learn from others, exchange ideas, and strengthen connections across the local SAP ecosystem.


Why Attend

  • Hear practical perspectives from SAP customers, partners, and community speakers
  • Explore key topics across architecture, development, automation, data and AI, strategy, and product updates
  • Connect with peers from across the SAP ecosystem
  • Experience a refreshed SAP Inside Track in a standout Sydney CBD venue


Venue

SAP Inside Track Sydney 2026 will be held at The Mint, one of Sydney’s most historic and distinctive venues.

Its heritage character, combined with a striking modern auditorium and courtyard surrounds, creates a unique backdrop for a reimagined SAP community event.

Located on Macquarie Street in the Sydney CBD, The Mint is conveniently within walking distance of Martin Place, Town Hall, and Wynyard.

The Mint, Sydney


Content Themes and Agenda

The agenda will feature a mix of presentations and demos designed to combine strategic insight with practical, real-world experience.

Planned content themes include:

  • Enterprise Architecture
  • Customer Stories
  • Development
  • Automation
  • Data and AI
  • SAP Strategy
  • Product Roadmaps and Updates

A draft agenda format is provided below.  More details on the agenda will be shared as the event planning progresses. 
Additionally, there will be breakout streams for hands-on labs and demos.

TimeSession
09:00am - 09:25amRegistration
09:30am - 09:50amWelcome and Opening Remarks
09:55am - 10:25am 

Session 1: Storytelling: Communicating Technical Concepts to a Non-technical Audience

Storytelling frameworks, lessons learned from previous projects and customers, and practical ideas that can help in progressing from technical roles into leadership and forward thinking positions.

 

10:30am - 11:00am

Session 2: Unlocking the Vault - Modern Cloud Data Stack for SAP

SAP environments hold the crown jewels of enterprise data, but traditional architectures often keep it trapped in rigid silos. To fuel the next generation of enterprise AI, organizations must move beyond simply migrating data—they need to liberate it.

This session unpacks how forward-thinking organizations are "unlocking the vault." We will explore how to build a high-performance, modern cloud data stack that bridges the gap between SAP’s rigid operational core and the agility of modern cloud ecosystems. Discover how to preserve your critical SAP semantic layer, maintain a strict "clean core" strategy, and feed trusted, real-time enterprise data into Agentic AI and advanced analytics engines to drive genuine business value.

 

11:05am - 11:25amMorning Tea
11:30am - 12:00pm

Session 3: From Sapphire Vision to the Autonomous Enterprise: What's Real, What's Next

At SAP Sapphire 2026, SAP announced its vision for the Autonomous Enterprise: a future where people set direction and AI executes, supported by governance, business context and human judgment.

This session explores the progress made since that announcement and what it means in practical terms for SAP customers, partners and practitioners. We will look beyond the headlines to examine what can already be done today with Joule and SAP Business AI Platform — and where the roadmap is heading next.

Through practical examples , attendees will see how autonomous capabilities can reshape enterprise work across finance, supply chain, procurement, HR, customer experience and industry processes.

Attendees will leave with a clearer understanding of what is possible now, what is coming next, and how SAP is moving from AI-assisted processes toward truly autonomous operations.

12:05pm - 12:35pm

Session 4:  From Fragmented Landscape to AI-Ready Enterprise

This session will share how Cochlear transformed its enterprise architecture approach during a major SAP S/4HANA program, moving from fragmented tools and siloed knowledge to a federated, insight-driven model using SAP LeanIX. The session will explain how Cochlear created a single source of truth for applications, integrations, and technology risk, achieving over 70% visibility of its technology landscape to support better decisions. It will also cover how architecture governance was embedded into delivery through ARB/DLRB integration, how data-driven risk management was established for areas such as vendor end-of-life and critical data flows, and how architects and delivery teams were enabled through a federated self-service model. Attendees will gain practical lessons on scaling architecture governance without slowing delivery, using LeanIX to drive measurable outcomes beyond documentation, and building an AI-ready enterprise architecture foundation for future decision automation.

 

12:35pm - 01:35pmLunch
01:40pm - 02:10pm

Session 5: AI-Assisted SAP Development with MCP (Virtual Presentation)

AI-assisted development in SAP is moving beyond simple code completion. With MCP servers and modern AI-enabled IDEs, developers can bring more relevant context into their workflow: SAP documentation, ABAP development objects, UI5/Fiori projects, CAP services, and more. In this session I will give a practical overview of what is already possible today. The focus is on realistic SAP development workflows across backend and frontend, showing how AI can support research, understanding existing code, generating ideas, and speeding up development without replacing developer judgment.

 

02:15pm - 02:45pm

Session 6: Panel Discussion | ECC to S/4HANA: Stay, Move, or Already There?

Join a candid customer panel exploring the different realities of the SAP ECC to SAP S/4HANA transition. Hear from SAP customers at various stages of the journey — from those still running ECC with no immediate move planned, to those preparing their transition, and those already live on SAP S/4HANA.

The discussion will cover the decisions, challenges, lessons learned, and practical insights that can help organisations better understand their own path forward. Expect real stories, honest reflections, and useful takeaways from customers who have faced, or are currently facing, the same questions.

 

02:45pm - 03:10pmAfternoon Tea
03:15pm - 03:45pm

Session 7: AI Agents for Multi-System Change SAP Delivery: Lessons from Real Deployments

Many enterprise change requests do not fit neatly into a single system. A single requirement may involve S/4HANA or ECC, BTP services, integration flows, and non-SAP systems like SendGrid for email delivery. That makes the hardest part of delivery less about writing code and more about deciding where the change belongs, how the systems should work together, and how to move from request to working outcome with acceptable effort and risk. In this session, I will use one concrete multi-system change request to show how AI agents can support that end-to-end process. Drawing on lessons from real deployments, I will walk through how agents help teams evaluate implementation options, choose an approach, estimate trade-offs, and build, run, and test the solution across the selected landscape. Attendees will leave with a clearer view of where agents add value in complex SAP change delivery, where human decisions remain critical, and what this looks like in a real enterprise workflow.

 

03:50pm - 04:20pm

Session 8:  The Drift That Haunts Your BTP

SAP BTP is both the platform you configure and the runtime you depend on. Both change over time and neither waits for the other. In on-premise systems that gap was contained through ownership and control. In the cloud you do not own the ground beneath your feet. The experience that made you good at on-premise becomes the instinct that blinds you here.
APIs change, credentials expire, services get deprecated. Drift is the gap between what you designed and what is actually running.
This session is for SAP BTP architects, platform owners, integration leads, and business focused stakeholders who have felt that gap but not yet named it.
We will explore six approaches teams use to manage drift, from manual operations to AI-assisted delivery. None is wrong, but each has costs that only appear under pressure.
You will leave with the right questions to bring back to your team.

 

04:25pm - 04:55pmWrap-up
05:00pm - 06:00pmNetworking Drinks
